parameters.query: SELECT config_key, value_numeric, value_bool FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('MODEL_PORTFOLIO_VALUE','MAX_TOTAL_OPEN_RISK_PCT','MAX_SECTOR_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_SINGLE_POSITION_PCT','MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS','MAX_DIRECTIONAL_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_PORTFOLIO_DRAWDOWN_PCT','CORRELATION_LOOKBACK_DAYS','MAX_PAIRWISE_CORRELATION','STRESS_RISK_REDUCTION_FACTOR','DRY_RUN','MAX_REGION_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_NON_EUR_EXPOSURE_PCT','MAX_PORTFOLIO_CHECK_ATTEMPTS','MAX_RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT','MIN_REWARD_RISK_RATIO','MAX_POSITION_VALUE_PCT','DEFAULT_FEES_BPS','DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS','MINI_FUTURE_LEVERAGE','MINI_FUTURE_SPREAD_PCT','MINI_FUTURE_FINANCING_PCT_PA');
SELECT * FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status IN ('open','proposed');
SELECT net_pnl, exit_time FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status = 'closed' ORDER BY exit_time;
SELECT region, combined_regime FROM trading.market_regime WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
SELECT symbol, trading_date, close FROM trading.stock_price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND trading_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date - 70 ORDER BY symbol, trading_date;

SELECT config_key, value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('DEFAULT_FEES_BPS','DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS','AMBIGUOUS_BAR_POLICY_CODE','MAX_DATA_ERROR_RETRIES','MINI_FUTURE_LEVERAGE','MINI_FUTURE_SPREAD_PCT','MINI_FUTURE_FINANCING_PCT_PA');
SELECT * FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status = 'open' OR (status = 'proposed' AND decision_time::date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date) OR status = 'data_error';
SELECT symbol, trading_date, open, high, low, close, data_quality_status FROM trading.stock_price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND trading_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date;
SELECT ticker, strategy, direction FROM trading.strategy_signals WHERE business_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AND valid_to IS NULL;
SELECT config_key, value_numeric FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key = 'MODEL_PORTFOLIO_VALUE';
SELECT ticker, direction, position_value, theoretical_quantity, simulated_entry_price, stop_price_initial, risk_amount, sektor FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status = 'open';
SELECT ticker, CASE WHEN exchange = 'XETRA' THEN 'Europa' WHEN exchange IN ('NASDAQ','NYSE') THEN 'USA' ELSE 'global' END AS region, currency FROM trading.stock_instruments;
